title: 恒流源给电容充电
statement: 电容 C = 100 µF 原来不带电（u_C(0) = 0）。从 t = 0 起，电流源以恒定电流 I_s = 2 mA 给它充电（t < 0 时 I_s = 0）。
求 t = 0.5 s 时的电容电压 u_C、电容吸收的功率 p_C，以及此时电容的储能 W_C。

questions.ask: t = 0.5 s 时电容吸收的功率 p_C = ?
questions.explain: 关联参考方向下 p_C = u_C·i_C = 10 × 2×10⁻³ = 0.02 W = 20 mW，为正，电容在吸收能量。

questions.ask: t = 0.5 s 时电容的储能 W_C = ?

hints: 电容的积分关系：u_C(t) = u_C(0) + (1/C)∫₀ᵗ i_C(ξ) dξ。电流恒定时积分就是 i·t。
电容储能只取决于此刻的电压：W_C = ½·C·u_C²。
solution: **1. 电压。** 电流源与电容串联，i_C = I_s = 2 mA（方向与 i_C 参考方向一致）。由 u_C(t) = u_C(0) + (1/C)∫₀ᵗ i_C dt：u_C(t) = (2×10⁻³ / 10⁻⁴)·t = **20t V**，电压随时间线性上升。t = 0.5 s 时 u_C = **10 V**。
**2. 功率。** u_C、i_C 为关联参考方向，p_C = u_C·i_C = 10 × 0.002 = **20 mW**（吸收）。p_C(t) = 0.04t W 也随时间线性增大。
**3. 储能。** W_C = ½Cu_C² = ½ × 10⁻⁴ × 100 = **5 mJ**。验算：∫₀^0.5 p_C dt = 0.04 × 0.5²/2 = 5 mJ ✓——电源送出的能量全部储存在电场中，理想电容不消耗能量。

en.title: Charging a capacitor with a constant current
statement: The capacitor C = 100 µF is initially uncharged (u_C(0) = 0). From t = 0 on, a current source charges it with a constant current I_s = 2 mA (I_s = 0 for t < 0).
Find the capacitor voltage u_C, the power p_C absorbed by the capacitor and the stored energy W_C at t = 0.5 s.

questions.ask: Power absorbed by the capacitor at t = 0.5 s, p_C = ?
questions.explain: With the passive sign convention p_C = u_C·i_C = 10 × 2×10⁻³ = 0.02 W = 20 mW; it is positive, so the capacitor is absorbing energy.

questions.ask: Energy stored in the capacitor at t = 0.5 s, W_C = ?
questions.explain: W_C = ½·C·u_C² = ½ × 100×10⁻⁶ × 10² = 5×10⁻³ J = 5 mJ. Integrating the power gives the same: ∫₀^0.5 (20t)(0.002) dt = 0.02 × 0.5² = 5 mJ.

hints: Integral form of the capacitor law: u_C(t) = u_C(0) + (1/C)∫₀ᵗ i_C(ξ) dξ. With a constant current the integral is just i·t.
The stored energy depends only on the present voltage: W_C = ½·C·u_C².
solution: **1. Voltage.** The current source is in series with the capacitor, so i_C = I_s = 2 mA (in the direction of the i_C arrow). From u_C(t) = u_C(0) + (1/C)∫₀ᵗ i_C dt: u_C(t) = (2×10⁻³ / 10⁻⁴)·t = **20t V**, a linear ramp. At t = 0.5 s, u_C = **10 V**.
**2. Power.** u_C and i_C follow the passive sign convention, so p_C = u_C·i_C = 10 × 0.002 = **20 mW** (absorbed). p_C(t) = 0.04t W also grows linearly.

**3. Energy.** W_C = ½Cu_C² = ½ × 10⁻⁴ × 100 = **5 mJ**. Check: ∫₀^0.5 p_C dt = 0.04 × 0.5²/2 = 5 mJ ✓ — all the energy delivered by the source is stored in the electric field; an ideal capacitor dissipates nothing.
